answer: Re-attestations are stored in prism and terrace lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the jetty graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1534 impostors cost 1866 times the honest price and take 8 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
